title: Pucho Na Haal e Karbala (Title)
body:
Pucho Na Haal-e-Karbala
Pucho Na Haal-e-Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayi Baqiyan Se Sada
Nana Ko Batlao Zara
Haye Zainab Ne Phir Rokar Kaha
Roti Hai Jane Murtuza
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Par Nahi Mere Rida
Haye Akhiyan Bahengi Ab Sada
Rokar Sakina Ne Kaha
Aao Phuphi Dekho Zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Baba Ka Sar Naize Chadha
Asghar Jo Pyasa Margaya
Apne Laho Me Bhar Gaya
Haye Maa Ka Sahara Chin Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim Jo Ghode Se Gira
Sara Badan Tukde Huwa
Haye Sahra Bikhar Kar Rah Gaya
Jis Dam Lagi Dil Par Sina
<<DIVIDER>>
Be-Dam Huwa Kadyal Jawan
Haye Qaimo Me Tha Matam Bapa
Abbas-e- Ghazi Ba-Wafa
Pyasa Lab-e-Darya Raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Shane Katakar Sogaya
